name: Carte des loyers: asking-rent indicators by commune (2025)
publisher: Ministère de la Transition écologique (DHUP), with ANIL

measures.definition: Asking rent: the modelled rent per m², charges included, of an unfurnished flat of one or two rooms advertised on leboncoin and SeLoger in the third quarter, times 50 m² (Borgo's flat size for one bedroom). Paris and Lyon are the mean of their arrondissements weighted by adverts.
Asking rent: the modelled rent per m², charges included, of an unfurnished flat of three rooms or more advertised in the third quarter, times 90 m² (Borgo's flat size for three bedrooms).

rights.edition: carte des loyers 2025 (files of 2025-12-11), apartments of 1-2 rooms and of 3+ rooms
rights.attribution: Ministère de la Transition écologique, carte des loyers 2025 (data.gouv.fr, update of 2025-12-11), Licence Ouverte 2.0. Borgo weights arrondissements by adverts and multiplies the rate per m² by a fixed flat size

vetted.notes: Official open data from the housing ministry; asking rents, modelled.

caveats: Asking rents of adverts, not rents paid, and charges included: higher than a sitting rent for the same home.
The 1-2 room rate is for flats of 37 m² on average and smaller flats cost more per m², so 50 m² at that rate can overstate a one-bedroom rent.
